high_level_description: The image shows two individuals outdoors on what appears to be a rooftop or elevated platform. The person on the left is sitting on the edge of the platform, wearing a dark blue t-shirt and matching shorts, along with red sneakers and white socks. They have long hair tied back and are wearing sunglasses. This person is making a playful gesture with their hands, forming a peace sign with one hand and sticking out their tongue with the other. The person on the right is standing and taking a selfie.
